segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ נוֹתְנִין כְּלִי תַּחַת הַנֵּר לְקַבֵּל נִיצוֹצוֹת, וְלֹא יִתֵּן לְתוֹכוֹ מַיִם מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהוּא מְכַבֶּה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One may place a vessel beneath the» oil «lamp» in order «to receive» burning «sparks» of oil that fall from the lamp so that they will not cause a fire. «And he may not place water into» the vessel «because he» thereby «extinguishes» the sparks.

moves.summary: the mishna permits a spark-catching vessel but forbids water in it

positions.claim: one may place a vessel under a lamp for sparks but may not put water in it, since that extinguishes
